summary: Blue Owl Capital Corp filed an 8-K reporting entry into a Third Amendment to its existing senior secured revolving credit facility and termination of a separate secured credit facility. The amendment extends the revolver availability period to June 2030, maturity to June 2031, increases the accordion to $6 billion, resets minimum equity test, and reduces total facility from $4.025B to $4.0B. The terminated facility was repaid in full and liens released. These are routine credit facility modifications and a facility termination, not a special situation. No special-situation event is present.
